I don't know. What do you have in mind?

Well, you're certain that you'd be distressed if you threw the shirt away because of your attachment to it, but maybe you're mistaken about that. What if we test your prediction about how bad you'll feel by actually getting rid of it and keeping track of how you feel?

I will definitely try.
